PHASE.NAME: UPGRADE_1 Indexing Pipeline Foundation
PHASE.GOAL: Implement the U2 and U3 indexing foundation: parallel file processing, deterministic full-index compatibility, incremental changed-file updates, deleted-file cleanup, and GraphRAG cache invalidation.

DATA_FLOWS.FLOW: Full index flow: root discovery selects source files, M-INDEXER-PIPELINE parses files in parallel, results are ordered deterministically, M-INDEXER-STORAGE replaces the snapshot, and GraphBuilder cache entries are invalidated for the root.

Incremental flow: CLI or watch input provides changed and deleted paths, M-INDEXER-PIPELINE upserts changed blocks, removes deleted-file blocks, persists the delta, and invalidates graph cache only for affected roots.

STEPS.step-1: Extract shared file-processing and StoredBlock construction from M-INDEXER into a pipeline module with stable ordering and bounded error reporting.
STEPS.step-2: Add Rayon-backed parallel parsing for full indexing while preserving existing gitignore behavior and search-result determinism.
STEPS.step-3: Add storage operations for per-file upsert and deleted-file removal without requiring a full snapshot rewrite.
STEPS.step-4: Expose an incremental indexing entrypoint for changed-file sets and route full indexing through the shared pipeline.
STEPS.step-5: Wire setup or watch-related entrypoints to request incremental index updates when a bounded changed-file list is available.
STEPS.step-6: Keep GraphRAG cache invalidation scoped to the indexed root and affected deltas.

RISKS.RISK: Parallel parsing can introduce nondeterministic result ordering unless StoredBlock ordering is normalized before persistence.
Incremental updates can leave stale graph or search entries unless deletion and cache invalidation are part of the same implementation gate.
